description.value: Northwinds Lodge is a 20-unit motel in Dawson Creek, British Columbia, operated as part of The Lodge Motor Inn group serving the Peace Country region. Rooms are fully modernized and include kitchenettes, individual climate control, and in-room fridges, making it practical for both short stopovers and extended stays. The property caters to a wide range of travellers including tourists and long-haul truckers, with large-vehicle parking and winter engine plug-ins available on site.
